name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@ea17c68df8912ef543352723c149a84f56e3d413 # v6.1.0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
      - name: Install Packages
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Lint
        run: pnpm run lint
      - name: Build
        run: pnpm run build
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node-version: [18.x, 20.x, 22.x, latest]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@ea17c68df8912ef543352723c149a84f56e3d413 # v6.1.0
      - name: Use Node.js ${{ matrix.node-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
      - name: Install Packages
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Test
        run: pnpm run test
  test-with-eslint-v10:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@ea17c68df8912ef543352723c149a84f56e3d413 # v6.1.0
      - name: Use Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
      - name: Install ESLint v10
        run: |+
          pnpm install -D eslint@10
          rm -rf node_modules
      - name: Install Packages
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Test
        run: pnpm run test
  test-for-svelte-v5:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@ea17c68df8912ef543352723c149a84f56e3d413 # v6.1.0
      - name: Use Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
      - name: Install Packages
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Test
        run: pnpm run test

  test-for-svelte-v4:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@ea17c68df8912ef543352723c149a84f56e3d413 # v6.1.0
      - name: Use Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
      - name: Install Svelte v4
        run: |+
          pnpm install -D svelte@4
          rm -rf node_modules
      - name: Install Packages
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Test
        run: pnpm run test

  test-for-svelte-v3:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node-version: [18.x]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@ea17c68df8912ef543352723c149a84f56e3d413 # v6.1.0
      - name: Use Node.js ${{ matrix.node-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
      - name: Install Svelte v3
        run: |+
          pnpm install -D svelte@3
          rm -rf node_modules
      - name: Install Packages
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Test
        run: pnpm run test
  test-with-ts-sys-hook:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        svelte-version: [3, 4, 5]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@ea17c68df8912ef543352723c149a84f56e3d413 # v6.1.0
      - name: Use Node.js latest
        uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: latest
      - name: Install Packages
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Install legacy Svelte
        if: matrix.svelte-version != 5
        run: pnpm install -D svelte@${{ matrix.svelte-version }}
      - name: Test with ts.sys hook enabled
        env:
          SVELTE_ESLINT_PARSER_EXPERIMENTAL_TS_SYS_HOOK: "1"
        run: pnpm run test
  update-fixtures:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@ea17c68df8912ef543352723c149a84f56e3d413 # v6.1.0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
      - name: Install Packages
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Update fixtures
        run: pnpm run update-fixtures
      - name: Check changes
        run: |
          git add --all && \
          git diff-index --cached HEAD --stat --exit-code
  test-and-coverage:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@ea17c68df8912ef543352723c149a84f56e3d413 # v6.1.0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
      - name: Install Packages
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Test
        run: pnpm run cover
      - name: Coveralls GitHub Action
        uses: coverallsapp/github-action@8d6379e14d29928660c4ba802d8e85393440b329 # v2.3.8
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
